spec_theorems.name: run_one_stdout_content
spec_theorems.informal: With exactly one PATH operand, standard output consists of the single resulting directory string computed from that operand.

spec_theorems.name: run_one_exit_success
spec_theorems.informal: With exactly one PATH operand, the utility completes successfully and returns exit status 0.

spec_theorems.name: run_one_stdout_length
spec_theorems.informal: With exactly one PATH operand, the utility writes exactly one output line.

spec_theorems.name: run_one_stdin_ignored
spec_theorems.informal: The utility does not use standard input, so changing stdin does not affect the result for the same PATH operand.

spec_theorems.name: dirname_no_slash
spec_theorems.informal: If the operand contains no slash characters, the resulting directory string is ".".
